title: Palm Tree Paradise | KEY.co
description_expanded: Each of the four bedrooms is thoughtfully designed for relaxation and convenience, featuring queen beds and TVs in three rooms, and a fun bunk bed setup in the fourth. The master suite boasts an en suite bathroom for added privacy. Modern amenities such as a full-size washer/dryer, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and a one-car garage enhance your stay. Nestled in a prime location, this beach house sleeps eight comfortably, offering a serene haven where every detail caters to an exquisite and carefree vacation experience. This stunning retreat offers a perfect blend of comfort and style, ideal for families or groups seeking a memorable seaside escape. The expansive living area, adorned with a large TV, invites guests to unwind and connect, while the fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar and adjacent dining area ensures delightful meals together. Step onto the covered front porch to savor the coastal breeze or explore the surroundings effortlessly with the included golf cart.
